_comment: ElevenLabs TTS configuration for Halo (Project ClearPath)
_model_id_note: Options: eleven_v3 (best quality), eleven_multilingual_v2 (29 languages, stable), eleven_flash_v2_5 (ultra-low latency, 50% cheaper), eleven_turbo_v2_5 (balanced)

voice_settings._stability_note: Range 0.0–1.0. Lower = more expressive/variable, Higher = more consistent/monotone. 0.5–0.7 is warm and natural.
voice_settings._similarity_boost_note: Range 0.0–1.0. How closely the AI sticks to the original voice. Higher = closer to the voice sample, lower = more variation.
voice_settings._style_note: Range 0.0–1.0. Amplifies the style of the original speaker. Higher = more dramatic/expressive. Keep below 0.5 for calm, approachable tone. Set to 0.0 to disable.
voice_settings._speed_note: Range 0.5–2.0. Speaking rate multiplier. 1.0 = normal. Below 1.0 = slower (gentler for elderly users). Above 1.0 = faster.
voice_settings._use_speaker_boost_note: Boosts similarity to the original speaker. Increases latency slightly but improves voice quality.

_apply_text_normalization_note: Options: auto, on, off. 'auto' lets the model decide (e.g. spelling out numbers). 'on' forces it. 'off' skips it.
_seed_note: Integer 0–4294967295 or null. Set a fixed seed for reproducible output. null = random each time.
_ffplay_dir_note: Directory containing ffplay.exe. Added to PATH at runtime so ElevenLabs can find it regardless of which terminal launches the app. Set to null to skip.
